prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 7 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean, simple line drawing: uniform thin black outlines on a plain white background, with no shading, hatching, grey tones, colour or texture. Each panel has a thin black border, with plain white gutters between the panels. Location: 殡仪馆门前, Bright day, strong sun from high front-right.
Image 1: the character sheet of 司念 (18), look S0
Image 2: the character sheet of 路人甲 (40)
Image 3: the location 殡仪馆门前, with no people
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image: the hairstyle, build and outfit in outline. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location image only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location image, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Outside the funeral home. The camera stays on the street side facing the building. The grey-brick building with its one pair of heavy double wooden doors is at frame back, and one flight of grey concrete steps leads down toward the camera. The street with a bicycle lane runs across the foreground; cyclists ride from screen right to screen left. Plane trees line the curb, and pedestrians in blue and grey walk past with an old bus in the distance. Si Nian stands in the open doorway at the top of the steps in burial clothes. Lu Ren Jia is off frame at screen right on his bicycle.
Panel 1: Wide shot, low angle from the street side, locked-off camera. Si Nian steps out of the double wooden doors in her burial clothes and walks down the concrete steps to the street edge, dazed.
Panel 2: Medium close-up, handheld, eye-level, slow orbit around Si Nian on the street side. Si Nian turns her head, staring at the bicycles, the old bus and the people in blue and grey clothes.
Panel 3: Medium shot, track following Lu Ren Jia from screen right to screen left, eye-level. Lu Ren Jia rides his bicycle along the lane past the steps, turns his head and sees Si Nian in burial clothes, and his jaw drops.
Panel 4: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye-level from the street side. Lu Ren Jia's front wheel twists and he topples sideways onto the asphalt with his bicycle, his blue cap flying off, while Si Nian stands at the foot of the steps.
Panel 5: Medium shot, low angle, push in on Si Nian. Si Nian drops to her knees on the asphalt and throws both arms up to the sky, tears running down her face.
Panel 6: Close-up, low angle on Si Nian's face against the sky. Si Nian laughs through her tears, her face bright with joy.
Panel 7: Wide shot, high angle from the street side, crane up and pull out. Si Nian kneels in the street with her arms raised, Lu Ren Jia sprawls behind his fallen bicycle staring at her, and the 1980s traffic flows around them.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering, shading or colour.
